internal.title: High Latency Incident in Ad Service Due to Resource Exhaustion
internal.body:
At 10:16 UTC on 2026-11-08, an alert for high latency was triggered on the ad service. Initial diagnosis identified resource exhaustion as the primary cause, with CPU utilization reaching 98% and slight memory growth. The latency p95 was elevated at 1.8 seconds, while error rates remained low at 0.2%, ruling out error injection as a cause.

The mitigation involved disabling the adHighCpu flag at 10:36 UTC, which led to a rapid recovery with latency dropping to 0.12 seconds. The incident was resolved shortly after the mitigation was applied.

Key timeline:
- 10:16:36 Alert received
- 10:36:17 Diagnosis confirmed resource exhaustion
- 10:36:23 Flag disabled
- 10:36:23 Recovery verified

No significant errors or warnings were found in logs during the incident.

This incident highlights the importance of monitoring CPU utilization closely and having automated flags to manage resource exhaustion scenarios.

external.body: Between 10:16 and 10:36 UTC on 2026-11-08, the ad service experienced elevated latency, which may have impacted response times. The issue was identified and resolved promptly, restoring normal service performance. We continue to monitor the service to prevent recurrence.
